narrative: Constructed; maximal contrast to E1 (light, formal, still, paper-warm). Third-generation estate/probate attorney, 25 years. Clients arrive after a death — grieving, executors by surprise, afraid of mistakes. She is precise, unhurried, quietly kind. Resulting direction: warm paper, walnut ink, engraved-letterhead gravity, totally still — the visual opposite of E1 on five axes, derived from signals not a 'lawyer template'.

summary_for_practitioner: Your site reads like warm engraved letterhead: cream paper, walnut ink, a steady serif voice, and complete stillness — because grieving families need to feel they're in careful, unhurried hands. Your twenty-five years and the estates you've settled sit right at the top, set in the same serif as the headline, so the proof calms before a single claim is made. No red, no countdowns, nothing that hurries a hard moment.
